solution:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads sign records, transforms each record into a pair (d + a, d - b), then scans the remaining pairs in repeated passes to track the largest coherent run size and the number of runs achieving that size, returning both values." solution]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> number_of_signs </REF>: integer "Number of sign records to read from standard input."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: tuple of two integers "The tuple (maximum_set_size, number_of_maximum_set_sized) containing the largest counted set size and the number of sets with that size."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read number_of_signs sign records. For each i from 0 to number_of_signs - 1, read one line with raw_input(), split it into d, a, and b, convert all three to int, append the computed tuple (d + a, d - b) to the initially empty list a_to_b. RESULT a_to_b]
            [COMMAND Set N = None, M = None, maximum_set_size = 1, number_of_maximum_set_sized = 0, current_set_size = 1, and is_finish = False. Remove the first tuple from a_to_b using a_to_b.pop(0) and unpack it into a_for_comparision and b_for_comparision. RESULT initial_state]
            [COMMAND While not is_finish and len(a_to_b) > 0, enter another scan of the current a_to_b list. RESULT outer_loop]
            [COMMAND Within the outer while loop, for each index and tuple tup in enumerate(a_to_b), set is_finish = True when index == len(a_to_b) - 1, then unpack a, b = tup and feed the tuple into the state-machine branches. RESULT current_tuple]
            [COMMAND Within that for loop, if N is not None and M is None, then when a is not equal to a_for_comparision, set M = b and b_for_comparision = b. In all cases, increment current_set_size by 1. RESULT state_after_N_branch]
            [COMMAND Within that for loop, else if M is not None and N is None, then when b is not equal to b_for_comparision, set N = a and a_for_comparision = a. In all cases, increment current_set_size by 1. RESULT state_after_M_branch]
            [COMMAND Within that for loop, else if M is not None and N is not None, then if b != b_for_comparision and a != a_for_comparision, close the current set: if current_set_size is greater than maximum_set_size, set maximum_set_size = current_set_size and number_of_maximum_set_sized = 1; otherwise if current_set_size equals maximum_set_size, increment number_of_maximum_set_sized by 1. Then reset current_set_size to 1, set N = None and M = None, replace a_to_b with a_to_b[index:], and break out of the for loop. Otherwise, increment current_set_size by 1. RESULT max_update_and_restart]
            [COMMAND Within that for loop, when N and M are both None and a == a_for_comparision and b == b_for_comparision, set a_for_comparision = a if N is None, set b_for_comparision = b if M is None, increment current_set_size by 1, and continue to the next tuple. RESULT state_after_exact_match]
            [COMMAND Within that for loop, still with N and M both None, else if a == a_for_comparision and b != b_for_comparision, then if N is None set N = a and a_for_comparision = N, set b_for_comparision = b, and increment current_set_size by 1. RESULT state_after_a_match]
            [COMMAND Within that for loop, still with N and M both None, else if b == b_for_comparision and a != a_for_comparision, then if M is None set M = b and b_for_comparision = b, set a_for_comparision = a, and increment current_set_size by 1. RESULT state_after_b_match]
            [COMMAND Within that for loop, still with N and M both None, else when both a and b differ from the stored comparison values, inspect a_to_b[index + 1]. If a equals a_to_b[index + 1][0], set N = a_to_b[index + 1][0], a_for_comparision = a_to_b[index + 1][0], and M = b_for_comparision. Otherwise, set M = a_to_b[index + 1][1], b_for_comparision = a_to_b[index + 1][1], and N = a_for_comparision. In both cases, increment current_set_size by 1. RESULT state_after_both_differ]
            [COMMAND After the for loop finishes, recheck the outer while condition. If the for loop was exited by the break in the closing-set branch and is_finish is still False, the next while iteration continues with the sliced a_to_b; if the break occurred on the last element, is_finish was already set to True, so the outer while loop exits. If the for loop completed without that break, is_finish is True and the outer while loop exits. RESULT outer_loop_recheck]
            [COMMAND When the outer while loop exits, return the tuple (maximum_set_size, number_of_maximum_set_sized). RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: number_of_signs is 0 before the initialization pop]
        [LOG "a_to_b is empty because the input-reading loop executed zero times, so a_to_b.pop(0) raises IndexError"]
        [THROW IndexError "No sign tuple is available to initialize a_for_comparision and b_for_comparision"]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: An input line from raw_input() does not contain exactly three whitespace-separated tokens]
        [LOG "sign.split() cannot unpack into d, a, and b, so a ValueError is raised"]
        [THROW ValueError "Input line is malformed"]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: Any token in the input line cannot be converted by int()]
        [LOG "int() conversion fails on d, a, or b, so a ValueError is raised"]
        [THROW ValueError "A sign field is not an integer"]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: During the both-differ branch of an inner scan, the current tuple has no following tuple because it is the last element of a_to_b]
        [LOG "The code evaluates a_to_b[index + 1] when index == len(a_to_b) - 1, which raises IndexError"]
        [THROW IndexError "No next tuple exists to seed N and M when the current tuple differs in both components"]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
